patches.title: 16-pad drum layout for selected plugins
patches.summary: Machinedrum Module / Machinemodule, 6W6, 8W8, CW-78, 9W9, TR-MPC and Lucky Dip get MPC's drum layout with all 16 pads lit.
patches.author: sd88me

patches.title: hwremap: remap the hardware buttons (MPC Live, Force)
patches.summary: Open any screen from any button, with double taps, long presses and Shift layers. MPC Live: Pad Bank A-D open the top row of the Mode Menu, + and - (and their double taps) the second row. Force: Mixer twice = Master, Menu twice = Main Mode, Knobs short/long swapped. Rules in /sdcard/hwremap.conf, edited any time; Shift keeps the original function.
patches.author: mmiroshnikov

supports.os: MPC Live Gen1 (Hakai, MPC 3.9.1) and Force (stock 3.9.0) tested; other models with your own rules

modifies: /etc/systemd/system/acvs.service.d/90-mpc-addins.conf (elsewhere: the LD_PRELOAD shared with the addins)

patches.title: Drive exec: run plugins from a noexec drive (an MPC/Force's SSD)
patches.summary: UNTESTED on a device by this project (testers wanted, see issue #150). MPC cannot load a plugin from a drive mounted noexec: it is listed but only shows Load Plugin. This makes one folder of the drive (Synths) executable, through a small boot-time service; the drive itself stays noexec.
patches.author: timomacquis (adapted by sd88me)

supports.os: MPC OS Gen1 (tried on a Force, MPC OS 3.9.1)

modifies: /media/<your drive>/Synths (an executable bind mount of the folder)
